regulation: Besluit beheer verpakkingen — Afvalfonds Verpakkingen / Verpact
title: Netherlands: packaging waste contribution above 50,000 kg
summary: A business placing more than 50,000 kg of packaging on the Dutch market in a year must report to and pay the waste management contribution to Verpact (formerly Afvalfonds Verpakkingen). Below that weight the contribution does not apply, though other packaging duties may.

sources.title: Besluit beheer verpakkingen 2014, Art. 8(1) (wetten.overheid.nl)
sources.note: Fetched the consolidated statute directly. Art. 8(1): 'De producent of importeur van wie het totaal van de door hem in de handel gebrachte verpakkingen ... jaarlijks meer dan 50.000 kilogram bedraagt, zendt elk jaar voor 1 augustus aan Onze Minister een verslag' -- the 50,000 kg/year threshold and the reporting duty it triggers are both confirmed exactly as drafted, resolving the previous draft's single biggest open question. Art. 8a(2) cross-references the same 50,000 kg figure for a related decree (Besluit regeling voor uitgebreide producentenverantwoordelijkheid), so the number is used consistently, not just in one place. TWO THINGS NOT YET MODELLED, found via Verpact's own guidance (not re-verified against the statute this pass): (1) single-use plastic and deposit-return packaging (cans, plastic drink bottles) have NO threshold -- registration is required from the first kilogram regardless of the 50,000 kg figure, which this row's applies_when does not carve out; (2) Verpact states the 50,000 kg threshold itself 'is expected to be removed' once PPWR's own producer-registration regime (eu.ppwr.producer-registration, already published) is fully implemented -- a future date-watch item, same shape as that row's implementing-act timing risk.

sources.title: Registration form Europe / Non-Europe | Verpact
sources.note: Confirms the threshold applies even to a business 'that does not have a place of business in the Netherlands but sells to Dutch consumers (online)' -- so organisation.established_in_market is correctly NOT part of this row's applies_when; the duty is market-of-sale-based, not establishment-based, unlike the AT/ES authorised-representative rows in this same batch.
